newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris sees greater 1997 expansion.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris sees greater 1997 expansion.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc said Wednesday it expected its 1997 expansion to be greater than its previous estimate of a net 15 to 20 new stores next year.
"We will be exceeding that," John Boyers, the company's treasurer, said in an interview. "How much, we will annoucne somewhere down the line.

Strong results in recent months prompted the company to decide to expand by more than the net 15-20 new stores it had planned. That figure represents the number of store openings, minus the number of underperforming stores being closed, Boyers said.
"We've been very happy with the reuslts that have been coming out last few months," Boyers said, noting that September comparable-store sales rose 35.3 percent from the same month a year ago.
In conjunction with the expansion plans, Paul Harris Wednesday named Ronda Hisiger to the newly created position of senior vice president of stores. She had been vice president.
